chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Nasr, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the man who slanders a young girl, he is flogged. He (peace be upon him) said: No, until she reaches adulthood.

key_terms.قَذَفَ: To slander or accuse of zina (unlawful sexual intercourse)
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: He is flogged (the standard hadd punishment)

ai.seo_question: When does the hadd punishment for slandering a girl begin?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the hadd punishment for qadhf (slander) is deferred for a pre-pubescent girl until she reaches bulugh (maturity), reflecting the juristic principle that the legal capacity for receiving the full penalty is tied to maturity. This distinction highlights the nuanced application of hudud in Shia fiqh, where the victim's status determines the timing and validity of the punishment. The ruling underscores the protective nature of Islamic law regarding the dignity of young girls before they attain full legal accountability.
